{"subject":"Congrats on the Visa and Mastercard P2P launch","body":"Hi,

Congratulations on launching Moov's peer-to-peer payment system with Mastercard and Visa in September. Bringing domestic P2P to banks, credit unions, neobanks and brokerages, with direct integration into existing digital banking platforms, is a meaningful step. It was also good to see Moov's ledger infrastructure integrated into a unified lending platform in October.

I'd love to hear how the rollout is going. Would you be open to a 20-minute call in the next few weeks?

Best,
Elena"}
